Every element and attribute of ES3D version 1 as implemented by the reference reader. Semantics are described in SPEC.md. Unknown attributes and elements are errors (with a "did you mean" suggestion); elements whose name starts with x- are vendor extensions and are skipped with a warning.

Common attributes

Scene nodes (shapes, containers, <use>, <scene>) accept these placement and style attributes in addition to their own. The local transform is transform · T(position) · R(rotation) · S(scale).

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
ididUnique identifier, referenced by <use ref>, material="…" and path="…".
namestringHuman readable label shown in tools.
transformttransformSVG-style transform list; applied outside position/rotation/scale.
positionpvec30,0,0Translation x,y,z.
rotationrotvec30,0,0Euler angles in degrees, applied about X, then Y, then Z.
scalescscale31,1,1Uniform scale or x,y,z.
visiblebooltrueWhen false the element and its children are not rendered.
materialmref → materialMaterial id. Inherited by descendants, like SVG fill.
colorccolorBase colour override. Inherited by descendants.

Document structure

<es3d>

Root element of an ES3D document.

Children: <title>, <desc>, <defs>, <scene>, <environment>, <controls>, <box>, <sphere>, <cylinder>, <cone>, <capsule>, <plane>, <torus>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon>, <path>, <extrude>, <revolve>, <sweep>, <gear>, <mesh>, <group>, <repeat>, <scatter>, <lod>, <use>, <light>, <camera>, <material>.

Attributes:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
version (required)stringFormat version; this implementation reads version 1.
unitm | cm | mm | km | in | ftmLength unit (informative).
xmlnsstringOptional. Ignored if present. A namespace is not required.
namestringHuman readable label shown in tools.

<title>

Document title.

Children: text content.

No attributes.

<desc>

Free text description.

Children: text content.

No attributes.

<defs>

Definitions that are not rendered directly; referenced with <use ref>.

Children: <box>, <sphere>, <cylinder>, <cone>, <capsule>, <plane>, <torus>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon>, <path>, <extrude>, <revolve>, <sweep>, <gear>, <mesh>, <group>, <repeat>, <scatter>, <lod>, <use>, <light>, <camera>, <material>.

No attributes.

<scene>

Optional wrapper for scene content; behaves like a group.

Children: <box>, <sphere>, <cylinder>, <cone>, <capsule>, <plane>, <torus>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon>, <path>, <extrude>, <revolve>, <sweep>, <gear>, <mesh>, <group>, <repeat>, <scatter>, <lod>, <use>, <light>, <camera>, <material>, <environment>, <controls>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).

<environment>

Background and ambient (hemisphere) lighting.

Children: none.

Attributes:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
backgroundcolor#171a1fClear colour.
skycolor#ccdbf2Ambient light colour from above.
groundcolor#403833Ambient light colour from below.
intensitynumber0.5≥ 0Ambient / environment intensity.
exposurenumber1> 0Tone mapping exposure.

Materials

<material>

Minimal physically based material (metallic/roughness).

Children: none.

Attributes:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
ididUnique identifier, referenced by <use ref>, material="…" and path="…".
namestringHuman readable label shown in tools.
colorccolor#cccBase colour (sRGB).
metallicnumber0≥ 0, ≤ 10 = dielectric, 1 = metal.
roughnessnumber0.5≥ 0, ≤ 10 = mirror, 1 = fully rough.
opacitynumber1≥ 0, ≤ 1Alpha; values below 1 are blended.
emissivecolor#000Emitted colour.
emissiveIntensitynumber1≥ 0Multiplier for emissive.
maptextureBase colour texture: image URL or checker(), grid(), stripes(), noise(), bricks().
normalMapnormalTextureNormal map: image URL or bumps(), tiles(), noise(), waves(), bricks().
normalScalenumber1Normal map strength.
uvScalevec21,1Texture repeat in u and v.
doubleSidedboolfalseRender back faces too.
unlitboolfalseIgnore lighting; output the base colour.
occlusionMaptextureOcclusion texture. The red channel darkens indirect light. Image URL or a procedural texture.
occlusionStrengthnumber1≥ 0, ≤ 1Strength of occlusionMap. 0 disables it, 1 uses the texture as stored.
metallicRoughnessMaptexturePacked texture: green multiplies roughness, blue multiplies metallic.
emissiveMaptexturesRGB texture multiplied with emissive.
alphaModeauto | opaque | mask | blendautoauto blends when opacity is below 1 and is opaque otherwise. mask discards fragments below alphaCutoff. blend uses opacity as coverage. opaque ignores alpha.
alphaCutoffnumber0.5≥ 0, ≤ 1Mask threshold.

Containers and instancing

<group>

Groups children under a common transform and style.

Children: <box>, <sphere>, <cylinder>, <cone>, <capsule>, <plane>, <torus>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon>, <path>, <extrude>, <revolve>, <sweep>, <gear>, <mesh>, <group>, <repeat>, <scatter>, <lod>, <use>, <light>, <camera>, <material>, <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).

<repeat>

Repeats its children count times; copy i is transformed by step applied i times.

Children: <box>, <sphere>, <cylinder>, <cone>, <capsule>, <plane>, <torus>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon>, <path>, <extrude>, <revolve>, <sweep>, <gear>, <mesh>, <group>, <repeat>, <scatter>, <lod>, <use>, <light>, <camera>, <material>, <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
count (required)nint≥ 0, ≤ 1000000Number of copies.
step (required)transformTransform applied cumulatively between copies.

<scatter>

Deterministic pseudo-random or grid placement of its children (seeded mulberry32).

Children: <box>, <sphere>, <cylinder>, <cone>, <capsule>, <plane>, <torus>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon>, <path>, <extrude>, <revolve>, <sweep>, <gear>, <mesh>, <group>, <repeat>, <scatter>, <lod>, <use>, <light>, <camera>, <material>, <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
countnint≥ 0, ≤ 1000000Number of random copies (random layout).
gridcount2Grid layout nx,nz (instead of count).
spacingvec21,1Grid cell size x,z.
areasize2Random layout: rectangle width,depth centred at the origin (XZ plane).
radiusnumber> 0Random layout: disc radius (XZ plane).
seedint1≥ 0Random seed.
jitternumber0≥ 0, ≤ 1Grid layout: random offset as a fraction of the cell.
randomScalerange3Per-copy scale: a range (uniform, e.g. 0.8..1.2) or x,y,z ranges.
randomRotationrange3Per-copy Euler ranges in degrees, e.g. 0,0..360,0.
randomMaterialids → materialPer-copy material chosen from this list of ids.

<lod>

Level of detail switch: child i is shown while the camera distance is below distances[i].

Children: <box>, <sphere>, <cylinder>, <cone>, <capsule>, <plane>, <torus>, <line>, <polyline>, <polygon>, <path>, <extrude>, <revolve>, <sweep>, <gear>, <mesh>, <group>, <repeat>, <scatter>, <lod>, <use>, <light>, <camera>, <material>, <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
distances (required)numbersIncreasing switch distances; one fewer than the number of children.

<use>

Instantiates the element with the given id (like SVG <use>).

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
ref (required)hrefref → nodeId of the element to instantiate.

Shapes

<box>

Axis aligned box centred at the origin, optionally with rounded edges.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
sizessize31,1,1Edge lengths (one value for a cube).
radiusrnumber0≥ 0Edge rounding radius.
segmentsint≥ 1, ≤ 32Rounding segments (automatic when omitted).

<sphere>

Sphere centred at the origin.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
radiusrnumber0.5> 0Radius.
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 512Fixed tessellation (automatic level of detail when omitted).

<cylinder>

Cylinder (or truncated cone) along Y, centred at the origin.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
radiusrnumber0.5> 0Bottom radius (and top radius unless radiusTop is set).
radiusTopnumber≥ 0Top radius.
heighthnumber1> 0Height.
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 512Fixed number of sides, e.g. 6 for a hexagonal prism.
capsbooltrueClose the ends.

<cone>

Cone along Y with its base at -height/2 and apex at +height/2.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
radiusrnumber0.5> 0Base radius.
heighthnumber1> 0Height.
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 512Fixed number of sides.
capsbooltrueClose the base.

<capsule>

Capsule along Y; height is the total height including both caps.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
radiusrnumber0.25> 0Radius.
heighthnumber1> 0Total height (at least 2 × radius).
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 512Fixed tessellation.

<plane>

Flat rectangle in the XZ plane facing +Y (rendered double sided).

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
sizessize21,1Width (x) and depth (z).

<torus>

Torus around the Y axis.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
radiusrnumber0.35> 0Distance from the centre to the tube centre.
tubenumber0.15> 0Tube radius.
arcangle360> 0, ≤ 360Swept angle in degrees (partial torus / pipe elbow).
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 1024Fixed segments around the ring.
tubeSegmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 512Fixed segments around the tube.

<line>

Straight line segment; rendered as a tube when radius > 0.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
from (required)vec3Start point.
to (required)vec3End point.
radiusrnumber0≥ 0Tube radius (0 = hairline).
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 256Tube sides.

<polyline>

3D polyline or 2D path outline; rendered as a tube when radius > 0.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
pointspoints3x,y,z x,y,z …
dpath2dOutline of 2D path data in the XY plane (alternative to points).
closedboolfalseConnect the last point to the first.
smoothboolfalseInterpolate the points with a Catmull-Rom spline.
radiusrnumber0≥ 0Tube radius (0 = hairline).
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 256Tube sides.

<polygon>

Filled flat polygon in the XY plane (rendered double sided).

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
points (required)points2x,y x,y … (at least 3 points).

<path>

Filled flat 2D path in the XY plane (rendered double sided). In <defs> it is a reusable outline.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
dpath2dSVG path data in the local XY plane (y up): M L H V C S Q T A Z.
pathref → pathId of a <path> element whose d is used.
fillRulenonzero | evenoddnonzeroHow nested contours become holes (SVG fill-rule).

<extrude>

Extrudes a 2D path along +Z, optionally with a rounded bevel.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
dpath2dSVG path data in the local XY plane (y up): M L H V C S Q T A Z.
pathref → pathId of a <path> element whose d is used.
fillRulenonzero | evenoddnonzeroHow nested contours become holes (SVG fill-rule).
depthnumber1> 0Extrusion depth along Z.
bevelnumber0≥ 0Bevel radius on the front and back edges.
bevelSegmentsint3≥ 1, ≤ 16Segments per bevel.
centerboolfalseCentre the extrusion on z = 0.

<revolve>

Revolves (lathes) a 2D profile around the Y axis; x is the distance from the axis.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
dpath2dSVG path data in the local XY plane (y up): M L H V C S Q T A Z.
pathref → pathId of a <path> element whose d is used.
fillRulenonzero | evenoddnonzeroHow nested contours become holes (SVG fill-rule).
angleangle360> 0, ≤ 360Revolution angle in degrees.
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 1024Fixed number of radial segments.

<sweep>

Sweeps a profile (circle or 2D path) along a 3D spine with rotation minimising frames.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
dpath2dSVG path data in the local XY plane (y up): M L H V C S Q T A Z.
pathref → pathId of a <path> element whose d is used.
fillRulenonzero | evenoddnonzeroHow nested contours become holes (SVG fill-rule).
radiusrnumber> 0Circular profile radius (alternative to d/path).
along (required)spineSpine: x,y,z points, 3D path data (M L C S Q T Z) or helix(r,pitch,turns).
smoothboolfalseInterpolate spine points with a Catmull-Rom spline.
twistangle0Profile rotation in degrees from start to end.
tapernumber1≥ 0Profile scale at the end (1 = constant).
capsbooltrueClose open ends.
segmentsint≥ 3, ≤ 256Circle profile sides.

<gear>

Involute spur gear in the XY plane, extruded along Z.

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
teethint24≥ 5, ≤ 400Number of teeth.
modulenumber0.04> 0Module: pitch diameter / teeth.
pressureAngleangle20≥ 10, ≤ 35Pressure angle in degrees.
depthnumber0.2> 0Face width (extrusion depth).
borenumber0≥ 0Radius of the centre hole.
bevelnumber0≥ 0Edge bevel radius.
centerbooltrueCentre the gear on z = 0.

<mesh>

Explicit indexed triangle mesh (escape hatch for data that is not procedural).

Children: <animate>.

Accepts the common attributes, plus:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
collidebooltrueWhen false the camera may pass through the element and its children (see <controls collide>).
positions (required)floatsx y z for every vertex.
indicesindicesTriangle vertex indices (3 per triangle); omitted = non-indexed triangles.
normalsfloatsOptional x y z normal per vertex (computed when omitted).
uvsfloatsOptional u v per vertex.
smoothangle30≥ 0, ≤ 180Crease angle for computed normals (0 = flat).

Lights and cameras

<light>

Directional, point, spot, ambient or hemisphere light.

Children: <animate>.

Attributes:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
ididUnique identifier, referenced by <use ref>, material="…" and path="…".
namestringHuman readable label shown in tools.
transformttransformSVG-style transform list; applied outside position/rotation/scale.
positionpvec30,0,0Light position (point/spot).
rotationrotvec30,0,0Euler angles in degrees, applied about X, then Y, then Z.
visiblebooltrueWhen false the element and its children are not rendered.
type (required)directional | point | spot | ambient | hemisphereLight kind.
colorccolor#fffLight colour.
intensitynumber1≥ 0Intensity multiplier.
directiondirvec3Direction the light travels (directional/spot).
targetvec3Point the light aims at (alternative to direction).
rangenumber0≥ 0Point/spot cut-off distance (0 = unlimited).
angleangle45≥ 1, ≤ 179Spot cone angle in degrees.
penumbranumber0.2≥ 0, ≤ 1Spot edge softness.
groundColorcolor#403833Hemisphere light colour from below.

<camera>

Perspective or orthographic camera. The first camera is the initial view.

Children: <animate>.

Attributes:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
ididUnique identifier, referenced by <use ref>, material="…" and path="…".
namestringHuman readable label shown in tools.
transformttransformSVG-style transform list; applied outside position/rotation/scale.
positionpvec30,0,10Eye position.
rotationrotvec3Euler orientation (used when no target is given; the camera looks down -Z).
targetvec3Point the camera looks at.
upvec30,1,0Up vector.
typeperspective | orthographicperspectiveProjection.
fovangle45≥ 1, ≤ 179Vertical field of view in degrees (perspective).
heightnumber10> 0Visible height (orthographic).
nearnumber> 0Near clip distance (automatic when omitted).
farnumber> 0Far clip distance (automatic when omitted).
aspectnumber1> 0Width / height of the view the author framed (e.g. 1.778 for 16:9). fov is the vertical angle at this aspect ratio.
fitcontain | cover | width | heightcontainHow the framed view adapts to other screens: contain keeps all of it visible, cover fills the screen, width and height keep that extent fixed.

Animation

<animate>

Animates a transform of its parent (position, rotation, scale; target and fov of a camera) over time or over page scroll.

Children: none.

Attributes:

AttributeAliasTypeDefaultRangeDescription
attr (required)position | rotation | scale | target | fovAnimated attribute. target and fov apply to <camera> only.
fromanimValueStart value (defaults to the parent value).
toanimValueEnd value.
valueskeyframesKey values separated by semicolons, e.g. 0,1,0; 2,1,0; 2,3,0 (instead of from/to).
keyTimesnumbersProgress (0 to 1) at which each of values is reached; evenly spaced when omitted.
alongspinePath to move along at constant speed (position and target): x,y,z points, 3D path data or helix().
smoothboolfalsePass through values or along points on a smooth (centripetal Catmull-Rom) curve.
durdurationDuration of one cycle, e.g. 4s or 500ms (required unless timeline="scroll").
beginduration0≥ 0Delay before the animation starts.
repeatrepeatCountindefiniteNumber of cycles or 'indefinite'.
alternateboolfalsePlay every second cycle backwards.
easinglinear | ease-in | ease-out | ease-in-outlinearTiming function.
timelinetime | scrolltimetime: plays by the clock. scroll: progress follows page scroll from 0 to 1 (dur, begin, repeat and alternate are not used).

Value types

TypeSyntax
angleNumber of degrees.
animValueThree numbers (one or three for scale, one for fov).
booltrue or false.
color#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(r,g,b), rgba(r,g,b,a) or a CSS colour name; sRGB.
count2Two positive whole numbers nx,nz.
durationTime: 4, 4s or 250ms.
enumOne of the listed keywords.
floatsWhitespace separated numbers (mesh data, stored as float32).
idIdentifier: a letter or _ followed by letters, digits, _ . : -.
idlistComma or space separated ids.
indicesWhitespace separated non-negative whole numbers.
intWhole number.
keyframesKey values separated by semicolons, each with as many numbers as from/to: 0,1,0; 2,1,0; 2,3,0.
normalTextureImage URL, or a procedural normal map: bumps(count,strength), tiles(count,strength,gap), noise(scale,strength,seed), waves(count,strength), bricks(count,strength).
numberDecimal number, e.g. 1, -0.25, .5, 2e-3.
numbersList of numbers.
path2dSVG path data: M L H V C S Q T A Z (absolute and relative), in the local XY plane with y up.
points2Point list x,y x,y ….
points3Point list x,y,z x,y,z ….
range3A range lo..hi used for x, y and z, or three comma separated ranges/numbers x,y,z.
refId of another element of the indicated kind.
repeatCountNumber of repetitions or indefinite.
scale3One number (uniform) or three numbers.
size2One number (both dimensions) or two numbers.
size3One number (all three dimensions) or three numbers.
spine3D spine: x,y,z x,y,z …, 3D path data (M L C S Q T Z with 3 numbers per point) or helix(radius,pitch,turns[,segmentsPerTurn]).
stringFree text.
textureImage URL, or a procedural texture: checker(count,color1,color2), grid(count,width,line,background), stripes(count,color1,color2), noise(scale,color1,color2,seed), bricks(count,brick,mortar); trailing arguments may be omitted.
transformSVG-style list: translate(x[,y[,z]]), rotate(x,y,z), rotate(a,ax,ay,az), rotateX(a), rotateY(a), rotateZ(a), scale(s), scale(x,y,z), quat(x,y,z,w), matrix(16 numbers, column-major); composed left to right.
vec2Two numbers x,y (comma and/or space separated).
vec3Three numbers x,y,z.
